mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates on future corporate cash flows and increasing equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in less than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines over 3 months, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 5.5% over two consecutive months signals weakening labor market conditions, which reduces inflationary pressure and increases the likelihood of future monetary easing, boosting equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX delivers negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both residential construction starts (HOUST) and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals a broad-based weakening in aggregate demand, which increases the probability of a policy response and triggers a risk-on rebound in equities over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST < 1550 and RSAFS < 615000 in the same month
regime_hint: demand contraction with policy response expectation
failure_condition: The interaction signal fails to generate positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or the joint effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in a regression of 60-day returns on the interaction term.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production (INDPRO) below 99.0 in two consecutive months indicates a contraction in real output, which increases the likelihood of a central bank intervention to prevent recession, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are negative in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly higher than the baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% combined with a CPI reading above 2.5% signals a tightening monetary cycle in response to inflation, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX delivers positive 5-day returns in more than 55% of triggered instances, or the interaction effect is not significant (p > 0.05) in a regression model.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in payroll employment (PAYEMS) and a rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a labor market slowdown, which increases the probability of a dovish policy shift, leading to positive equity returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS declines > 50k and UNRATE rises > 0.2pp in the same month
failure_condition: The joint signal fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or the interaction term is not significant (p > 0.05) in a regression of returns on the interaction.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) below 610,000 million dollars for two consecutive months indicates weakening consumer demand, which increases the likelihood of fiscal or monetary stimulus, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are negative in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the average return is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production (INDPRO) below 99.0 combined with a decline in GDP growth (GDPC1) below 1.0% annualized signals a contraction in real output, which increases the probability of a policy response and triggers a risk-on rebound in equities over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < 99.0 and GDPC1 < 1.0% (annualized) in the same quarter
failure_condition: The interaction signal generates negative or flat 60-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or the joint effect is not significant (p > 0.05) in a regression model.
